cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've copied 'Regards' from your message. No kisses; a proper goodbye.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's my work-email signature. I was sending you a soup recipe for your cold.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Businesslike, yes. That's how my last breakup started: polite advice instead of 'love you'.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The final kindness. Will it be in a container you don't need back?

reason: Make A copy an automatic work signoff as an interpersonal goodbye, changing A own expression of affection; B corrects its origin, and actual soup offer then feeds the feared-ending interpretation.
